jobs.program: Summer Clerkship 2027/28 — NSW Clerkship Recruitment Program
jobs.notes: Scheme-wide open date is confirmed (9 June 2027, 9:00am AEST) with offers from 8 September 2027, but the page lists two alternative closing dates (Sunday 4 July and Sunday 11 July 2027) depending on the employer, so no single close date can be stated; individual signatory firms apply these dates to their own programs.

jobs.employer: Queensland Law Society (scheme-wide, all signatory firms)
jobs.program: Seasonal Clerkship and Graduate Recruitment — 2027 program cycle
jobs.notes: QLS publishes a 2027 key-dates table and states the cycle commences with clerkship recruitment in July/August, but the exact 2027 open and close dates could not be read off the live page, so they are left null rather than guessed.

Firm's own early careers page confirms the 2026/2027 round has closed and that 2027/2028 clerkships will be advertised in line with the relevant Law Society/Institute guidelines, but no 2027/28 dates are yet published.
